strings.note: Hover label over the closed recipe book standing on the counter. 8 px display face on a 132-unit plate, one line, ~16 characters.
Subtitle under the house name on the recipe book's title page. 16 px body face, one line in a ~296-unit column.
Three-word tagline under the drink picture on the book's title page. Keep the dots. 16 px, one line, ~296 units.
Hint at the foot of the book's title page: the contents are on the facing page. 16 px, one line, ~296 units.
Small heading over the story's owed line on the book's title page (what a guest is still waiting for). 8 px, one line.
Heading over the list of newly perfected recipes on the book's title page. 8 px, one line, ~296 units. {n} is the count (1 here).
As book.title.news_head#one; {n} is how many recipes were newly perfected (2 or more).
Replaces " & " inside a recipe name in the book's index and news rows, because the 16 px body face draws & as an unreadable glyph. Keep the space on each side.

The owed line on the book's title page. {who} is the story guest's name in capitals (a person's name, never translated), {drink} the recipe name in capitals, {night} a weekday in capitals. 8 px, one line, ~280 units.

The host's warning on the book's title page before the guest's visit: stock this style. {style} is a spirit style in capitals (e.g. MEZCAL), {who} the guest's name in capitals, {night} a weekday in capitals. 8 px, one line, ~280 units.
Heading of the book's contents page. 16 px display face, one line.
Placeholder in the contents page's search box, shown while it is empty. 16 px, one line in a ~280-unit box.
Shown in the contents list when the search finds no recipe. 16 px, one line, ~296 units.
Back row at the top of an opened chapter's list in the contents; the < is the arrow. 16 px, one line.

Recipe count under a chapter title in the contents. {n} is the number of recipes. The English prints POURS even for one; kept as shipped. 16 px, may wrap to a second line of ~226 units, joined to the other counts with ' · '.
As book.contents.chapter_pours#one.
How many recipes in the chapter are perfected, after the pour count in the contents (joined with ' · '). {n} is the count. 16 px.
As book.contents.chapter_perfect#one.
How many recipes in the chapter are not bought yet, last on the contents count line (joined with ' · '). {n} is the count. 16 px.
As book.contents.chapter_locked#one.

strings.text: A CHAPTER OPENS ITS OWN LIST HERE
strings.note: Hint under the chapter rows on the contents page. 16 px, wraps to at most two lines of ~296 units.
Tag at the right of a not-bought recipe's row in the contents (when no star gate applies). 8 px, right-aligned in 60 units.
Tag at the right of a perfected recipe's row in the contents, beside a rosette. 8 px, right-aligned in 60 units.
Chapter line at the top of a recipe page the bar has not bought. {chapter} is the tier name (recipes.tier.*). 16 px, one line, ~296 units.
Tiny caption under the price on a recipe page. 8 px, one line in 120 units.

strings.text: THE POUR · ONE DOT IS A FIFTH
strings.note: Caption over the five-dot legend on a recipe page: each dot is 20% of the drink. 16 px, one line, 296 units (it is already near full).
Under an ingredient's name on a recipe page when the shelf has no bottle of it. 8 px, one line, 200 units, shares the line with the dots.
Under the exact share on a perfected recipe's ingredient row. 8 px, right-aligned in ~72 units.

strings.text:
WHAT GOES IN IT IS SEALED
BUY THE PAGE TO READ IT
strings.note: Replaces the ingredient rows on a recipe page the bar has not bought. Two lines (keep the line break), 16 px, 296 units, 44 tall.
How full the glass must be, on a recipe page. {pct} is a whole number (e.g. 80). 16 px, one line, 296 units.
The player's best accuracy for this drink so far, on a recipe page not yet perfected. {pct} is a whole number. 16 px, one line, 296 units.
Row label on a locked recipe page's star gate: the rating the page wants. 8 px, 72 units, followed by a row of stars and a number.
Row label under book.gate.opens_at: the bar's rating tonight. 8 px, 72 units.
A locked recipe page's gate when it is not a star gate. {sentence} is the unlock condition as Core says it (English until the unlock pass). 16 px, wraps inside a 284x36 plate.

strings.text: NOT ON THE HOUSE LIST YET
strings.note: A locked recipe page's gate when no unlock condition is known. 16 px, inside a 284x36 plate.
How a drink is worked: poured from the keg. Shown on the recipe page, recipe card and day-end market tile. 16 px, a short word.
How a drink is worked: poured straight. 16 px, a short word.
How a drink is worked: shaken in the tin. 16 px, a short word; also the first spec row.
How a drink is worked: stirred. 16 px, a short word.
How a drink is worked: built in the glass, not shaken or stirred. 16 px, a short word.
A preparation ask's name on the licence and order tip chips (hover caption). 16 px, one line, short.
A preparation ask's name on the licence and order tip chips (hover caption). 16 px, short.
Garnish/preparation ask: served over ice. Licence and order tip chip caption. 16 px, short.
Garnish ask: a curl of lemon peel. Licence and order tip chip caption. 16 px, short.
Garnish ask: the glass rim run through salt. Licence and order tip chip caption. 16 px, short.
Garnish ask: the glass rim run through sugar. Licence and order tip chip caption. 16 px, short.
Preparation ask: pulled from the tap. Licence and order tip chip caption. 16 px, short.

How the drink is worked and what glass it goes in, under the name on a recipe page and the licence's recipe card. {prep} is a recipes.prep.* word, {glass} a glass name in capitals (HIGHBALL, COUPE). 16 px, one line, ~260 units.
An ingredient row that needs a better bottle: {label} is the ingredient word, {tier} the minimum bottle tier (2-6); T is short for tier. Two spaces before T. 16 px, one line on a spec row.
An ingredient row that accepts any bottle of this kind (brand-agnostic orders). 16 px on a spec row, ~140 units.
As recipes.type.spirit, for beer.
As recipes.type.spirit, for a sweetener (syrup, liqueur).
As recipes.type.spirit, for citrus/sour.
As recipes.type.spirit, for bitters/amaro.
As recipes.type.spirit, for soda/sparkling.
As recipes.type.spirit, for a garnish.
Footnote under an ANY SPIRIT row explaining the word. 8 px, one line, ~280 units; the dots have no spaces.
Footnote under an ANY BEER row explaining the word. 8 px, one line.
Footnote on a recipe's spec once the player has made it perfectly. 8 px, one line.
Footnote on a recipe's spec before it is perfected. {pct} is the best make's accuracy as a whole number. 8 px, one line.
Spec row label for how full the glass must be; the amount (e.g. 80%+) sits at the right of the row. 16 px, short.
Red tag on an ingredient row when the shelf has no such bottle. 8 px, right-aligned in 60 units.
Tiny caption under the price on the licence's hover recipe card (same words as book.page.on_the_tab). 8 px, 110 units.
Caption over the five-dot legend on the licence's hover recipe card: each dot is 20% of the drink. 16 px, one line; the card is narrower than the book page (~260 units).
Difficulty word beside three lit red pips (recipe page, recipe card, market hover, day-end tile). 16 px or 8 px, short.
Difficulty word beside two lit amber pips. 16 px or 8 px, short.
Difficulty word beside one lit green pip. 16 px or 8 px, short.

strings.text: Hard to make — a lot to pour, and plenty of work in it.
strings.note: Body sentence explaining a hard drink, on the day-end market's recipe detail. Sentence case, wraps.

strings.text: Medium — more to pour, or it has to be worked.
strings.note: Body sentence explaining a medium drink, on the day-end market's recipe detail. Sentence case, wraps.

strings.text: Easy to make — a few pours and nothing to work.
strings.note: Body sentence explaining an easy drink, on the day-end market's recipe detail. Sentence case, wraps.

strings.text:
INGREDIENTS SEALED
BUY THE PAGE TO READ IT
strings.note: Replaces the ingredient rows on the market's hover card for a recipe not bought. Two lines (keep the line break), 16 px, wraps in a narrow card.
Recipe tier / book chapter name (ranks 1-8). Chapter title in the contents (16 px display face, ~226 units) and the eyebrow over a recipe's name.
Recipe tier / book chapter name (ranks 9-14). As recipes.tier.starter.
Recipe tier / book chapter name (ranks 15-21). As recipes.tier.starter.
Recipe tier / book chapter name (ranks 22+). As recipes.tier.starter.
Last item of a one-line ingredient list (styles joined with ' · '). {pct} is a whole number. Rich-text colour tag stays in code. 16 px.
Name used for a drinker who has no papers on file: on the licence (in capitals) and over their head. One word.
How well the bar knows a drinker, on the licence's (currently hidden) standing line: first visit. 8 px, short.
Relationship rank 0 on the licence's standing line. 8 px, short.
Relationship rank 1 on the licence's standing line. 8 px, short.
Relationship rank 2 on the licence's standing line. 8 px, short.
Relationship rank 3 on the licence's standing line. 8 px, short.
Why somebody was shown the door when they did not need to be: fills {reason} in id.kick.shown_door (in capitals) and ends a service-log line (lower case).

Kick reason: the licence belongs to somebody else. Fills {reason}; lower case in the service log.
Kick reason: an honest card, too young. Fills {reason}; lower case in the service log.
Toast after kicking the drinker from the licence. {reason} is an id.kick_reason.* line in capitals. Toast, one line.
Licence field 5 value when the drinker asks for no garnish. Two spaces each side of the dot. 8 px, one line, ~400 units.
Title of the hover tip over an unread drinker's ticket. 16 px display face, one line, ~220 units.

strings.text: CLICK THEM TO READ THEIR ID
strings.note: Hint under id.tip.ready: clicking the drinker opens their licence. 9 px, one line, ~220 units.
Small heading over the garnish chips in a read drinker's hover tip. 8 px, one line.
Licence field label; the number stays, three spaces after it. 8 px caption over a tiny ruled field, ~12 characters at most.
Licence field label; the number stays, three spaces after it. 8 px in a 100-unit field, ~10 characters at most.
Licence field label for the drinker's country; the number stays, three spaces after it. 8 px, ~16 characters at most.
Licence field label for the drink they want; the number stays, three spaces after it. 8 px, ~12 characters.
Licence field label for garnish asks (a pun on a driving licence's endorsements); the number stays, three spaces after it. 8 px, ~18 characters at most (chips start 150 units in).

Second line of the licence's header band: the city (Miami, a proper noun), the document class, and a trailing dot before the licence number that follows it. Two spaces each side of each dot. 8 px, 170 units.
The red key on the licence that throws the drinker out. 16 px on an 84x30 key (~76 units of face): 4-5 characters.
Caption heading the licence's punch row (one punch per visit). 16 px, 64 units before the punches start: ~7 characters.
Caption heading the licence's star row (the drinker's average rating of the bar). 16 px, 64 units: ~6 characters.

strings.text: CLICK OUTSIDE TO GIVE IT BACK
